port.description: Port number on which the CUPS daemon listens (typically 631).

listen_addresses.description: List of additional IP addresses (with optional ports) to listen on, e.g., ['192.168.1.10:631', '10.0.0.5:631']. Leave empty to listen only on localhost.

items.description: A network interface address (and optional port) to bind the CUPS listener to.

allow_remote_admin.description: Whether to allow remote users to perform administrative tasks via the web interface orIPP.

allow_browsing.description: Enable or disable printer browsing and advertisement via CUPS-Browsing.

require_auth.description: Whether authentication is required for administrative access (e.g., adding/removing printers).

log_level.description: CUPS log verbosity level (e.g., debug, info, warn, error).

log_file.description: Path to the CUPS error log file.

default.comment: Allow internal LAN to view status

access_rules.description: Access control rules for different network ranges and operations.

comment.description: Human-readable description of this rule's purpose.

auth_required.description: Whether authentication is required for this rule's scope.

allowed_user.description: Required username or group (e.g., '@SYSTEM' for admin users) when auth_required is true.

share_printers.description: Whether to enable sharing of locally attached printers on the network.

printcap_file.description: Path to the printcap file (used by legacy BSD-style printing tools).

max_job_size.description: Maximum job file size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before the server shuts down (if no active jobs or listeners).

server_name.description: Canonical hostname displayed to clients in the CUPS interface and job reports.

default_language.description: Default language code for messages and UI (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'fr').

default_charset.description: Default character set used by the CUPS web interface and logs (usually 'utf-8').

max_clients.description: Maximum total number of concurrent client connections.

max_clients_per_host.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections per remote host.

preserve_job_files.description: Whether to retain job files on disk after printing completes (for troubleshooting or auditing).

preserve_job_history.description: Whether to preserve job history records (e.g., job state, duration) in the CUPS database.
